question: Does the generative effect of rotate-back whitening and the explicit token hierarchy depend on whether covariance is conditioned along features, sequence, both axes, or the complete flattened latent?

scope_correction.completed_phase_l: analyzed all four ZCA variants but trained the objective factorial only on axial gamma 1
scope_correction.current_phase: complete the missing channel, sequence, and flattened gamma-1 factorial cells without rerunning the four axial cells
scope_correction.total_matrix: four ZCA variants by four prior objectives; 16 cells total, 12 new

channel.definition: apply 16-dimensional feature ZCA identically inside every native token

sequence.definition: apply 64-dimensional sequence ZCA identically to every feature, then rotate back

axial.definition: Kronecker product of sequence and channel ZCA, then rotate back
axial.status: four cells complete; reuse Phase-L results

flattened.definition: complete 1024-dimensional ZCA, then rotate back to the native 64x16 partition
flattened.interpretation_caveat: native token-index interventions remain operational after rotate-back but act on less token-local outputs

token_intervention.ordering: native token index with no permutation
objective_cells: ordered token time / tempered token loss
token_intervention.clean_magnitude: no explicit token rescaling; every cache uses its tensor-wide population normalization

training.recipe: prior seed 1, width 512, depth 12, eight heads, QK RMS normalization, batch 256, 60000 optimizer steps, learning rate 1e-4, 1000 warmup, 50-step Heun evaluation seed 54321
training.evaluation: all 12 new cells receive decoded FID/KID-5k
training.selection: within each transform, compare timing and weighting against exact-cache controls; compare each common/uniform cell against native v27 and the completed axial cell
training.ten_thousand_rule: advance an improvement, an FID gap below two from its relevant control, or an FID/KID disagreement; a concordant loss above two may stop
training.promotion: only a concordant 10k improvement of at least two FID over native v27 motivates replication or intermediate-gamma follow-up
